name: signbridge
description: SignBridge: connecting hands, bridging worlds. Run both the frontend and the optional backend together with one command.

scripts.dev: node scripts/print-banner.js && concurrently -n frontend,backend -c blue,green --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.dev:all: node scripts/print-banner-all.js && concurrently -n frontend,backend,experimental -c blue,green,yellow --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:experimental"
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix frontend && python -m pytest ml/tests backend/tests -v
